scope: diagnostics and test-only QR prototype; production assessment still uses the existing observation-scale Jacobian TSQR

definitions.J: P - Z C, where C is the stored correction divided by observation scale
definitions.full_gram: P^T P - P^T Z C - C^T Z^T P + C^T Z^T Z C
definitions.orthogonality_gram: P^T P + C^T Z^T Z C; used only as a measured approximation when Z^T P is small

test_only_orthogonal_stack_QR_candidate.factor: QR of stacked [R_P; -R_Z C], with projected and design response coordinates stacked alongside; no Gram eigendecomposition or normal-equation solve

near_zero_residual_note.interpretation: The residual-normalized ratio is ill-conditioned for the width-0.42 near-exact-fit fixture; the observation-scale-normalized stationarity residual remains small.

decision.compact_exact_reformulation: promising for a test-only prototype on the measured cases
decision.production_replacement: not approved by this evidence; near-threshold Jacobian rank fixtures, endpoint assessment parity, and production resource/time behavior remain unmeasured
decision.normal_equations: not used as a substitute for QR
